role: Official questions, solutions and marking scheme
edition: Complete unofficial Korean translation in original PDF layout
translation_method: Direct Korean translation authored by Codex without external translation APIs.

layout_and_fonts.korean: NotoSansKR 400/700; bold and underlining follow the corresponding original expressions
layout_and_fonts.latin_math: Original source NotoSans and mathematical glyphs, explicitly routed by actual source coverage and role; source Unicode maps restored only in inserted font wrappers. All used contours and new Unicode verified.
layout_and_fonts.identifiers_retained: Scientific formulas, units, variable symbols, question/page codes and physical reagent-bottle labels such as R1-syn/R1-an/Py-qual/Dithiz./Solvent are retained. Corresponding item descriptions and instructions are Korean.
layout_and_fonts.native_stacked_fraction: 18 original source glyphs retain exact relative coordinates and sizes as selectable native PDF text; original red fraction bar is relocated with exact geometry and width. Private layout markers are completely removed.

qa.underline_method: Only isolated original textual 0.6575 pt underline strokes under replaced English prose are removed; matching Korean expressions receive native PDF underlines. Borders, scientific diagrams, formulas and blanks are excluded. Exact removed coordinates are recorded in build QA.
qa.page_code_word_bbox_exception: Native large page-code word bbox can include the separate language caption. Actual code region above y=130 is verified RGB-identical when this causes a false positive.
qa.font_name_matching: Lowercase alphanumeric normalization removes spaces, punctuation and hyphens; every Hangul span must use prepared NotoSansKR Regular/Bold or explicitly prepared Oblique/BoldOblique, independently of fallback names.

independent_source_unicode_glyph_validat.new_parser: Tokenized arrays and UTF-16BE increments; source maps unchanged.

visual_review.checked: Colored solution and rubric paragraphs, table/answer boundaries, native chemical diagrams, p6 selectable stacked fraction with one native vector line, p7 equilibrium diagram margins and all ten headers.

source_inconsistencies_and_details_prese: Q3.3 red solution and blue rubric differ in accepted neighboring box offsets; each original statement and point value is preserved separately. The word Box is translated as 칸, with original prime and +/- offsets retained.

The source guide prints P3 question count as 4 pages, while the standalone Q3 source has 6 pages. This S3 combined question, solution and marking packet has 10 pages, including the original mostly blank Q3.2 page.

Q3.4 reasoning distinguishes the 2:1 incremental titration volumes from the 3:2 total endpoint-volume ratio printed with the graph; all original ratios and stated x mM versus x/2 mM concentrations are retained.

Q3.5 original explanation assumes equal hydrogen-ion concentrations and unchanged pH, whereas the question statement gives pH values rounded to integers. The official reasoning is translated faithfully rather than replaced with a new proof.
